intentAndPurpose.intent: Hierarchical trail of parent links plus the current page. Items carry `id`/`label` with optional `href`/`onPress`/`renderLink`. Current item defaults to the last entry (`currentId` override). Optional count-based middle collapse via `overflow` + `maxItems` (min 3). `appearance` resolves colour roles against the parent <Surface> (no sparkle/brand-bg in the public union). `homeAsIcon` replaces the first label with a home IconButton. Truncation + Tooltip are opt-in (`truncate`/`tooltip`, default true).

props.name: items
props.description: Ordered trail items: `{ id, label, href?, onPress?, disabled?, renderLink? }`. Current page is plain text by default.

props.name: currentId
props.description: Stable id of the current page item. Defaults to the final item.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Multi-accent role. Explicit non-'auto' wins; 'auto' inherits the nearest <Surface> role, falling back to 'neutral'.

props.name: homeAsIcon
props.description: Render the first item as a home IconButton instead of a text link.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Total visible positions including the overflow trigger. Minimum 3.

props.name: maxWidthItem
props.description: Per-item truncation width in density pixels (default = Tooltip-Max-Width = Spacing-40 × 2).

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Optional maximum width for the whole trail.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show a Tooltip only after a label is measured as clipped (trigger: click).

props.name: overflowLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the overflow trigger.
